1120940513543229441.a: #WednesdayWisdom Belshazar asks Daniel, "What does 'mene mene tekel upharsin' mean?" I think it a clever pun. Each word has multiple meanings. I like to read it as 50/50, weighed and divided. This may imply the world is divided good/evil; you get to place one shekel on the scale.
